drawings.title: Day 1: Parenting Practices
drawings.caption: This one is kind of special because it has been praised by Uncomfortable himself for being able to tell a story. Also I really started to apply saturated terminators here.

drawings.title: Day 2: Tiny Alien Terrarium
drawings.caption: Applied some perspective and lighting, as usual. Also this was my first time discovering iridescence.

drawings.title: Day 3: Spreading the Good Word
drawings.caption: This one really hit home. I pushed the saturation on the terminators here, providing a strong metallic sensation.

drawings.title: Day 4: Door to Door Sales in an Unusual Neighbourhood
drawings.caption: This drawing was made to celebrate the fact that Primagens became an open species. I really love the lighting on this one.

drawings.title: Day 5: Your Unusual House Guest
drawings.caption: This one is my favourite out of all. The gesture of the dog/fox creature and the 3d aspect of it is incredible to me.

drawings.title: Day 6: Travel the distance
drawings.caption: Unfortunately I was kinda tired already and I wasn't particularly feeling this, so I really didn't like this one.

drawings.title: Day 7: Halloween Takes Over
drawings.caption: This one is also really good. I kinda made something like a movie poster by placing two different light sources with different colors.
